第1章-adjacent

adjacent 邻近的；毗邻的
📖 词组
  • /əˈdʒeɪsnt/
  • adjacent buildings in Terminus's capital → 端点星首都的相邻建筑
  • the adjacent rooms in the Foundation's headquarters → 基地总部的相邻房间
  • adjacent planets in the star system → 星系中的邻近行星
  • the Mule's forces occupied the adjacent sector → 骡的部队占领了邻近区域
  • adjacent territories on the outer worlds → 外围世界的毗邻领土
🔗 近义词
neighboring 邻近的；附近的
/ˈneɪbərɪŋ/
neighboring planets in the outer worlds → 外围世界的邻近行星
neighboring and adjacent → 邻近的与毗邻的
neighboring countries → 邻国
adjoining 毗邻的；紧挨着的
/əˈdʒɔɪnɪŋ/
adjoining rooms on Terminus → 端点星上的毗邻房间
adjoining and adjacent → 毗邻的与邻近的
adjoining properties → 毗邻的房产
contiguous 相毗邻的；连续的
/kənˈtɪɡjuəs/
contiguous territories of the outer worlds → 外围世界的毗邻领土
contiguous and adjacent → 相毗邻的与邻近的
contiguous zone → 毗连区
nearby 附近的；邻近的
/ˌnɪrˈbaɪ/
nearby settlements on Terminus → 端点星上附近的定居点
nearby and adjacent → 附近的与邻近的
nearby location → 附近地点
bordering 接壤的；相邻的
/ˈbɔːrdərɪŋ/
bordering territories on the outer worlds → 外围世界的接壤领土
bordering and adjacent → 接壤的与邻近的
bordering countries → 接壤的国家
⚡ 反义词
distant 遥远的；疏远的
/ˈdɪstənt/
distant planets in the galaxy → 银河中遥远的行星
distant and adjacent → 遥远的与邻近的
distant relative → 远亲
remote 遥远的；偏僻的
/rɪˈmoʊt/
remote regions of the outer worlds → 外围世界的偏远地区
remote and adjacent → 遥远的与邻近的
remote village → 偏远的村庄
🌱 同根词
adjacency 邻近；毗邻
/əˈdʒeɪsnsi/
the adjacency of the buildings on Terminus → 端点星上建筑的邻近性
adjacency and proximity → 邻近与近邻
spatial adjacency → 空间邻接
adjacently 邻近地；毗邻地
/əˈdʒeɪsntli/
adjacently located buildings on Terminus → 端点星上邻近位置的建筑
adjacently and nearby → 邻近地与附近地
adjacently placed → 邻近放置的
adjacent-to 邻近...的
/əˈdʒeɪsnt tuː/
adjacent-to-the-spaceport area → 邻近太空港的区域
adjacent-to and nearby → 邻近的与附近的
adjacent-to-the-coast → 邻近海岸的
📎 派生词
adjacent-room 相邻房间
/əˈdʒeɪsnt ruːm/
adjacent-room in the Foundation's headquarters → 基地总部的相邻房间
adjacent-room and connected → 相邻房间且相连的
adjacent-room doors → 相邻房间的门
adjacent-building 相邻建筑
/əˈdʒeɪsnt ˈbɪldɪŋ/

adjacent-building and close → 相邻建筑且靠近的
adjacent-building entrance → 相邻建筑的入口

第1章-aggravate

aggravate 加重；使恶化；激怒
📖 词组
  • /ˈæɡrəveɪt/
  • civil war aggravated the Empire's decline → 内战加重了帝国的衰落
  • the Mule's attack aggravated the crisis → 骡的攻击使危机恶化
  • poor trade policies aggravated tensions with Terminus → 糟糕的贸易政策加剧了与端点星的紧张关系
  • the council's inaction only aggravated the situation → 议会的不作为只会使局势恶化
  • his arrogant attitude aggravated the negotiators → 他傲慢的态度激怒了谈判代表
🔗 近义词
worsen 恶化；使更糟
/ˈwɜːrsn/
the crisis worsened on Terminus → 端点星的危机恶化了
worsen and aggravate → 恶化与加重
worsening conditions → 日益恶化的条件
exacerbate 使恶化；使加剧
/ɪɡˈzæsərbeɪt/
the drought exacerbated the food shortage → 干旱加剧了粮食短缺
exacerbate and aggravate → 使恶化与加重
exacerbate tensions → 加剧紧张关系
intensify 加剧；增强
/ɪnˈtensɪfaɪ/
the conflict intensified on Trantor → 川陀上的冲突加剧了
intensify and aggravate → 加剧与加重
intensify the debate → 加剧辩论
compound 使恶化；增加
/kəmˈpaʊnd/
economic problems compounded the political crisis → 经济问题使政治危机恶化
compound and aggravate → 使恶化与加重
compound the problem → 使问题更复杂
provoke 激怒；挑衅
/prəˈvoʊk/
provoke the Empire into war → 激怒帝国开战
provoke and aggravate → 激怒与加重
provoke a response → 激起回应
⚡ 反义词
alleviate 减轻；缓解
/əˈliːvieɪt/
alleviate the suffering on Trantor → 缓解川陀上的苦难
alleviate and aggravate → 减轻与加重
alleviate poverty → 减轻贫困
soothe 安抚；缓解
/suːð/
soothe tensions between the factions → 安抚各派系之间的紧张关系
soothe and aggravate → 安抚与激怒
soothe the conflict → 缓解冲突
🌱 同根词
aggravation 加重；恶化；恼怒
/ˌæɡrəˈveɪʃn/
the aggravation of the crisis on Terminus → 端点星危机的恶化
aggravation and frustration → 恼怒与挫折
constant aggravation → 持续的恼怒
aggravated 加重的；激怒的
/ˈæɡrəveɪtɪd/
aggravated circumstances on Trantor → 川陀上的加重情节
aggravated and worsened → 加重的且恶化的
aggravated assault → 加重攻击罪
aggravating 使人恼火的；加重的
/ˈæɡrəveɪtɪŋ/
aggravating factors in the conflict → 冲突中的加重因素
aggravating and irritating → 使人恼火的且激怒的
aggravating circumstances → 加重情节
📎 派生词
aggravation-prone 容易恶化的
/ˌæɡrəˈveɪʃn proʊn/
aggravation-prone conflicts on Terminus → 端点星上容易恶化的冲突
aggravation-prone and volatile → 容易恶化且不稳定的
aggravation-prone situations → 容易恶化的情况
aggravation-driven 由恶化驱动的
/ˌæɡrəˈveɪʃn ˈdrɪvn/
aggravation-driven policies on Trantor → 川陀上由恶化驱动的政策
aggravation-driven and reactive → 由恶化驱动且反应的
aggravation-driven changes → 由恶化驱动的变化

第1章-Antarctic

antarctic 南极的；南极地区的
📖 词组
  • /ænˈtɑːrktɪk/
  • Antarctic ice fields on Terminus's southern pole → 端点星南极的冰原
  • the Foundation's Antarctic research outpost → 基地的南极研究前哨
  • Antarctic temperatures plunged to record lows → 南极温度降至历史最低点
  • a frozen Antarctic landscape on the outer worlds → 外围世界上的南极冰封景观
  • the Mule's coldness was Antarctic in its intensity → 骡的冷酷程度堪比南极
🔗 近义词
southern 南方的；南部的
/ˈsʌðərn/
the southern continent of Terminus → 端点星的南部大陆
southern and antarctic → 南方的与南极的
southern hemisphere → 南半球
polar 极地的
/ˈpoʊlər/
polar ice caps of Terminus → 端点星的极地冰盖
polar and antarctic → 极地的与南极的
polar bear → 北极熊
glacial 冰川的；极冷的
/ˈɡleɪʃl/
glacial pace of change on Terminus → 端点星上冰川般的变化速度
glacial and antarctic → 冰川的与南极的
glacial ice → 冰川冰
frigid 严寒的
/ˈfrɪdʒɪd/
frigid temperatures in the southern region → 南部地区的严寒温度
frigid and antarctic → 严寒的与南极的
frigid zone → 寒带
frozen 冰冻的
/ˈfroʊzn/
frozen wastelands of Trantor's lower levels → 川陀底层冰冻的荒地
frozen and antarctic → 冰冻的与南极的
frozen tundra → 冻原
⚡ 反义词
tropical 热带的
/ˈtrɑːpɪkl/
tropical climate of Terminus's equator → 端点星赤道的热带气候
tropical and antarctic → 热带的与南极的
tropical island → 热带岛屿
equatorial 赤道的
/ˌekwəˈtɔːriəl/
equatorial heat on Terminus → 端点星上的赤道高温
equatorial and antarctic → 赤道的与南极的
equatorial region → 赤道地区
🌱 同根词
